record_type: adaptive exploratory opportunity search; not a controlled discovery benchmark

initial_brief.user_supplied: Consequential unmet need, specific limitation, constructed testable transformation, same-offering economics; no supplied final application; flagship must exceed identified prior art.
initial_brief.excluded_headlines: Familiar backup capacity, coordination, diagnostics, ordinary optimization; parent additionally flagged active lanes PEtab, QIF/manufacturing, ecological demand, satellites, microscopy, evidence construction, methane/software repair.
initial_brief.agent_supplied: Seven candidate connections, primary-source screening, mechanical-order erasure construction, classical XOR repair, and ambiguity falsifiers.
initial_brief.not_supplied_or_measured: No real buyer, human expert search, ordinary frontier-model search trace, live paid-model run, physical laboratory result or earned revenue.

search_provenance.method: Adaptive primary-source web search followed by closer-art rejection. Initial digital candidates were redirected into distinct physical domains after a parent scope update.
search_provenance.bounded_execution: 31 query strings across nine search requests and six direct page opens in this agent subtask; this count is retrospective, not a preregistered equal-budget comparison.
search_provenance.comparison_boundary: No inference about beyond-human foresight or missed opportunities by ordinary users is supported. A candidate absent from this list is not proof of novelty.
search_provenance.leakage_boundary: The agent saw its evolving source results and parent messages; this is exploratory search. No historical replay claimed.
search_provenance.ranking: Ordinal priority for useful further technical inspection after source review; not market desirability or a numerical novelty score.

selection.rationale: C1 permits a decisive cheap exhaustive test and shows exactly why an unusual physical narrative plus ordinary coding is insufficient for flagship selection.
selection.status: No candidate in this subtask earned substantive novelty. Root may combine independent search results, but these rejected candidates should not be promoted without new evidence.

candidates.name: Battery-free event-history material with recoverable order information
candidates.beneficiary: Operators handling assets in locations where powered history logging is burdensome.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Recover the complete ordering of specified events despite one unreadable sensor cell, or decline when recovery is ambiguous.
candidates.existing_approaches: Mechanical sequence memory, hysteron latches, finite-state materials and standard error-correcting codes.
candidates.specific_limitation: A complete set of one-copy pairwise event-order bits has minimum Hamming distance one: one erased comparison can hide an adjacent transposition.
candidates.what_changed: Recent physically tunable interactions and three-body effects make richer history-processing materials plausible.
candidates.agent_connection: Connect mechanical neighboring-order memory to erasure-correcting order codes, then ask which physical information must be added.
candidates.construction: Exhaustive permutation encoder, independent precedence-constraint recovery oracle, standard XOR repair, and fixed new-size validation.
candidates.falsifier: One known erased readout produces multiple allowed histories under the same acceptance rule; this occurs in bare pairwise memory.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: A possible future design-and-qualification contract plus per-unit artifact supply; no buyers, price, hardware cost or physical reliability validated.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Executable order-memory capacity and ambiguity evaluator, known parity construction, failure cases, scope metadata.
candidates.verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP; preserve as constructed exploratory result
candidates.reason: The exact repair is classical XOR coding. No one-bit mechanical realization, total component-resource advantage, or substantive advance over the general hysteron-design prior art was established.
candidates.origin: Agent generated after physical pivot; no event-history application was supplied in the initial user brief.

candidates.name: Create an intervention that makes a scientifically unidentifiable mechanism distinguishable
candidates.beneficiary: Scientific groups whose available observations support multiple mechanisms.
candidates.valuable_outcome: A newly feasible experiment that can distinguish mechanisms while maintaining the scientific purpose.
candidates.existing_approaches: Structural identifiability, optimal experimental design and identifiability-guided autonomous agents.
candidates.specific_limitation: More data of the same observational class cannot resolve structural nonidentifiability.
candidates.what_changed: Frontier reasoning and symbolic software can inspect model symmetries and generate experiment alternatives.
candidates.agent_connection: Treat the experiment class itself as a constructed capability, not a fixed benchmark.
candidates.construction: Freeze a mechanism family, prove an ambiguity, construct an admissible intervention and test discrimination under noise.
candidates.falsifier: A named prior method already generates the same intervention under equal access, or the proposed intervention changes the scientific question.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Paid scientific design services or milestone-based research; ordinary commercial value might exist independently of novelty.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Mechanism models, intervention-generation procedures and falsifiers with source provenance.
candidates.reason: LLM-IDEA directly targets this mechanism. The proposed version supplied no substantive technical advance; diagnostic framing also conflicts with the requested flagship gate.
candidates.origin: Agent-generated exploratory candidate, then rejected by primary-source search.

candidates.name: Sell a useful collective signal that reveals no individual sample information
candidates.beneficiary: Organizations with complementary data that cannot freely disclose individual records.
candidates.valuable_outcome: A usable joint statistic or decision signal under a precise privacy model.
candidates.existing_approaches: Perfect sample privacy, synergistic disclosure, information-theoretic privacy and secure computation.
candidates.specific_limitation: Naive disclosure and aggregation can reveal individual information; privacy guarantees depend on distributions and side information.
candidates.what_changed: Agents can search disclosure policies and exact finite models more readily.
candidates.agent_connection: Treat complementary information as a new product rather than exchanging raw records.
candidates.construction: Finite-distribution optimization with explicit individual-information constraints and an independent leakage checker.
candidates.falsifier: The same disclosure is already produced by the prior-art optimization or fails after allowed side information.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: A paid data product with participant compensation; customer value and consent must be modeled independently.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Finite disclosure-policy evaluator and scope/rights metadata.
candidates.reason: The central counterintuitive possibility is explicit 2019 prior art. An agent wrapper or new fictional buyer does not earn substantive novelty.
candidates.origin: Agent-generated candidate; not present as application in the user brief.

candidates.name: Preserve useful learning while making deletion claims executable at release time
candidates.beneficiary: Operators needing to remove data influence from released learning artifacts.
candidates.valuable_outcome: A concretely checked released artifact satisfying a stated deletion reference.
candidates.existing_approaches: Certified unlearning, retained-set retraining and executable release certificates.
candidates.specific_limitation: Mathematical deletion statements do not automatically apply to finite-precision deployed artifacts or sequential downstream copies.
candidates.what_changed: Release verification and tracing across composed agent systems are active 2026 research topics.
candidates.agent_connection: Make deletion an operational output contract across the learning path.
candidates.construction: Frozen small model and deletion sequence, independent retraining reference and concrete artifact comparison.
candidates.falsifier: It only checks an intermediate equation or ignores feedback/derived data; or it reproduces identified release-certification work.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Qualified deletion/verification service, with liability and scope defined; no market estimate supplied.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Reference evaluator and versioned deletion-scope specifications.
candidates.reason: Direct recent prior-art subject found; no new theorem or construction beyond that subject established. Full primary text was not inspected, so this is a conservative novelty rejection rather than a performance comparison.
candidates.origin: Agent-generated digital candidate, abandoned before construction.

candidates.name: Temporal impedance transformation without a spatial matching component
candidates.beneficiary: Developers of compact wave-routing or sensing systems with changing loads.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Broadband impedance transformation that cannot be obtained by leaving the medium static in the same geometry.
candidates.existing_approaches: Spatial impedance matching, temporal interfaces and temporal tapers.
candidates.specific_limitation: Finite abrupt temporal sections have reflection bands; real devices have finite switching time.
candidates.what_changed: 2026 experiments demonstrate smooth temporal taper hardware.
candidates.agent_connection: Treat time-varying material structure as an extra productive degree of freedom.
candidates.construction: Transmission-line simulation with finite switching dynamics, dispersion, loss and modulation work; compare static, abrupt and taper protocols.
candidates.falsifier: The method is the existing temporal taper or fails under finite length, timing, loss or power constraints.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: A design or hardware-development offering; customer willingness to pay must be separate from simulated wave performance.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Validated dynamic network models and energy-accounting procedures.
candidates.reason: The desired new productive possibility has already been experimentally realized by identified prior art. A faster parameter search would be ordinary optimization.

candidates.name: Time-programmed catalysis opens a product-selectivity region unavailable at steady state
candidates.beneficiary: Chemical producers facing unfavorable static catalyst tradeoffs.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Selective production of a desired product at acceptable yield and energy cost under dynamic operation.
candidates.existing_approaches: Catalytic resonance and dynamic pathway selection.
candidates.specific_limitation: A static catalyst can face rate/selectivity compromises across elementary reaction steps.
candidates.what_changed: Programmable catalyst stimulation and current computational tools make transient pathways investigable.
candidates.agent_connection: Search over time-programmed physical mechanisms instead of optimizing a fixed steady-state catalyst.
candidates.construction: A mass-conserving kinetic model calibrated to a named chemical system; compare all allowed static states, mixing and dynamic policies with external energy included.
candidates.falsifier: An earlier dynamic-catalysis policy already reaches the region, or the apparent gain comes from omitted energy, fictional rate constants or changed product obligations.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Milestone-based process development and later value-sharing only after validated production; no imported profit totals.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Kinetic models, transient pathways, mass/energy accounting and unsuccessful regimes.
candidates.reason: The specific static-to-dynamic selectivity transformation is explicit prior art. No new chemistry or new mechanism was identified or calibrated.
candidates.origin: Agent-generated after instructions to broaden into temporal physical interactions.

candidates.name: A processing chip whose fluid dynamics store and execute a useful sequence
candidates.beneficiary: Users needing compact self-contained multi-step fluid processing.
candidates.valuable_outcome: Sequence-conditioned routing or processing with fewer external control interfaces.
candidates.existing_approaches: Pneumatic finite-state computers and newly demonstrated fluidic hysterons.
candidates.specific_limitation: Typical chips rely on external pressure/electrical control; a new physical memory substrate does not automatically supply a reliable program.
candidates.what_changed: Recent fluid-structure feedback experiments broaden the substrate for passive memory.
candidates.agent_connection: Combine fluidic memory with the process being performed so the material both carries the work and state.
candidates.construction: Conservative fluid-network model with realizable pressure sources and explicit routing predicates; equal resource and power comparisons.
candidates.falsifier: The function is already provided by pneumatic FSMs, or a hypothetical threshold graph does not correspond to the device physics.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Application-specific development and manufactured chips; any alleged cost saving needs complete fabrication and control costs.
candidates.successor_inheritance: Fluidic state-machine models, pressure/flow conservation checks and program acceptance conditions.
candidates.reason: Embedded fluidic finite-state execution is already established. A different physical implementation or lower control overhead was not enough to establish a new offering or substantive functional advance.
candidates.origin: Final inexpensive physical probe; not supplied by user.

sources.title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
sources.scope: Places a three-way identifiability/plateau decision inside an agent loop and tests protocol changes. It directly anticipates the candidate of discovering a new intervention class when ordinary experiments cannot identify the system. No conclusion about all possible scientific discovery is inferred.

sources.title: Data Disclosure under Perfect Sample Privacy
sources.authors: Borzoo Rassouli; Fernando E. Rosas; Deniz Gunduz
sources.scope: Constructs useful collective disclosure while preventing information disclosure about individual samples under a specified distributional model. Thus useful joint information without individual information is prior art. This is not interchangeable with differential privacy or unrestricted side-information robustness.

sources.title: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning
sources.authors: Ziyu Zhao; Xinyu Wang; Xiaowen Chang; Yixuan He
sources.type: primary preprint metadata; full text not inspected
sources.scope: Its title and bibliographic existence establish that executable release certification for unlearning is already an explicit research subject. Detailed performance claims were not verified from its primary full text and are not used here.

sources.title: Emergent disorder and mechanical memory in periodic metamaterials
sources.scope: A periodic frustrated mechanical lattice stores history through noncommuting responses. Its four-event example uses neighboring event-order relations to recognize selected sequences. The current abstract C4 probe studies that pairwise information model; it does not reproduce the full mechanics or claim a correction to the physical experiment.

sources.title: Controlled pathways and sequential information processing in serially coupled mechanical hysterons
sources.scope: Serially coupled hysterons already support designed pathways, finite-state-machine descriptions, counting, pattern generation and recognition. Merely connecting mechanical memory to these functions is not a new contribution.

sources.title: Generalizing multiple memories from a single drive: The hysteron latch
sources.scope: Frustrated two-hysteron units store nested memories under asymmetric driving. The elementary latching construction scales to longer sequences. A new wrapper around two-element sequence memory would not establish novelty.

sources.title: Transition graphs of interacting hysterons: structure, design, organization and statistics
sources.type: primary journal article, full text inspected
sources.scope: Defines general state-dependent switching thresholds, scaffolds, avalanches and inverse graph-realization inequalities. It explicitly includes higher-order and nonreciprocal interactions; race conditions are identified as ill-defined in the coarse model. General inverse graph synthesis cannot be claimed as a new discovery here.

sources.title: Mechanical hysterons with tunable interactions of general sign
sources.scope: Realizes tunable cooperative/frustrated and nonreciprocal pairwise interactions using rigid bars and springs, and builds sequence-computation examples. This makes a physical path more plausible but already supplies broad sequence-processing capability.

sources.title: Materializing split, mixed, and three-body interactions using rotor-based mechanical hysterons
sources.scope: Reports split interaction strengths, mixed-sign nonreciprocity and tunable three-body effects. These broaden available physical components; they do not establish that a proposed seven-bit parity device exists or that its couplers and ancillas are free.

sources.title: Visco-Bits: temporal-coding-inspired viscoelastic metamaterial for mechanical memory expansion
sources.authors: Aman Thakkar; Jose R. Rivas-Padilla; Andres F. Arrieta
sources.scope: Temporal material dynamics and order-dependent memory expansion are already an explicit contribution. Adding duration as an extra state variable to an athermal model is therefore not by itself a novelty claim. Metadata gives different online and issue dates; only year used.

sources.title: Experimental realization of a full-band wave antireflection based on temporal taper metamaterials
sources.type: primary journal article, full text inspected
sources.scope: Already constructs temporal taper impedance matching, reducing reflection without an added spatial transformer. The experiment uses a finite transmission line, synchronized pulses and external modulation. A new simulation of this principle would reproduce identified prior art, and external modulation energy must be accounted for.

sources.title: Catalytic resonance theory: parallel reaction pathway control
sources.scope: Dynamic catalyst modulation already selects products beyond a static-catalyst selectivity limit in its model. Thus discovering that alternating conditions can produce a selectivity unavailable to every static condition would be a reproduction unless a new physical mechanism or unsupported region is demonstrated.

sources.title: Fluidic Hysterons and Memory in Flow Networks
sources.authors: Abhineet Singh Rajput; Amir A. Pahlavan
sources.scope: Elastic fibers in channels yield fluidic hysterons, with a bypass controlling bistability and interactions. This offers a new physical substrate but does not make fluidic finite-state control an original concept.

sources.title: Pneumatic computers for embedded control of microfluidics
sources.authors: Siavash Ahrar; Manasi Raje; Irene C. Lee; Elliot E. Hui
sources.scope: Demonstrates integrated pneumatic finite-state controllers and liquid handling on one chip, including programmable logic and several memory bits. The requirement of external pressure power is explicit. A fluid-only controller for a processing sequence is already an established offering direction.

sources.title: Error Detecting and Error Correcting Codes
sources.scope: Classical coding theory supplies parity checks and the distinction between error detection and correction. The parity repair in this study is explicitly conventional; changing its application to mechanical event order does not make the coding principle novel.

constructed_probe.epistemic_status: Exhaustive abstract discrete computation. Actual material, human, model-performance and commercial claims are not established.

next_validation.smallest_useful_step: A materials expert can check whether a specified passive layout physically implements an encoded event-history predicate under a complete component budget. Start with a signed energy/threshold model and a declared workload, compare the full general hysteron-synthesis and classical-code controls, then fabricate only if a functional gap remains.
next_validation.novelty_falsifier: If the proposed predicate is realizable by the named conventional constructions at the same physical budget and obligations, reject the discovery headline even if delivery could be commercially useful.
next_validation.do_not_do: Do not relabel code parity, spare sensors, generic graph synthesis or post hoc robust optimization as a new physical breakthrough.
